description: This Java source file is a Spring MVC Controller class that manages product reviews in an admin web interface. It includes methods to display product reviews, handle pagination requests, delete reviews, and setup menu navigation.

classes.name: ProductReviewController
classes.description: Controller class managing product reviews in the admin section, including viewing, paging, and deleting reviews.

methods.name: displayProductReviews
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the product reviews page for a specific product. Validates product existence and ownership.

methods.name: pageProductReviews
methods.description: Handles POST requests to fetch a paginated list of reviews for a product, returning JSON data.

methods.name: deleteProductReview
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a specific product review by ID, with authorization checks.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the menu navigation context for the views.
